اقترنا (form VIII)

# اِقْتَرَنَّا (iqtarannā) /iq.ta.ran.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِقْتَرَنَ (iqtarana)
# اِقْتَرِنَا (iqtarinā) /iq.ta.ri.naː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَرَنَ (iqtarana)
